stories.headline: SpaceXAI launches Grok 4.5, its first Cursor-trained agentic model

key_facts.fact: SpaceXAI announced Grok 4.5 on July 8, 2026, its latest model and first major release since going public and acquiring Cursor.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceXAI, led by Elon Musk, has announced the release of its latest AI model, Grok 4.5. This marks the company's first major launch since going public and acquiring the AI coding startup Cursor.

key_facts.fact: Axios described Grok 4.5 as primarily a coding and agentic-work model rather than a consumer chatbot.
key_facts.excerpt: Grok 4.5 is designed primarily as a coding and agentic-work tool, rather than a consumer-focused chatbot.

key_facts.fact: The model is priced at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens.
key_facts.excerpt: It's competitively priced at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens.

key_facts.fact: Cursor said Grok 4.5 was built for complex, long-duration tasks across software engineering, data science, finance, and legal work.
key_facts.excerpt: According to the announcement by AI coding agent Cursor, Grok 4.5 excels at handling complex, long-duration tasks requiring creative problem-solving across various fields such as software engineering, data science, finance, and legal work.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-Live voice models for simultaneous conversation

key_facts.fact: OpenAI launched GPT-Live on July 8, 2026, as a new generation of voice models for more natural ChatGPT conversations.
key_facts.excerpt: On Wednesday, the company launched GPT-Live, a new generation of voice models that aims to make talking with AI feel even more like having a conversation with a human.

key_facts.fact: GPT-Live uses a full-duplex architecture that enables simultaneous listening and speaking.
key_facts.excerpt: At the heart of the upgrade is a new full-duplex architecture, which enables simultaneous listening and speaking, reducing latency and creating a more natural experience.

key_facts.fact: The voice model can offload deeper reasoning to GPT-5.5 at launch while continuing the conversation.
key_facts.excerpt: When a query requires deeper reasoning, GPT-Live offloads that request to another model, GPT 5.5 at launch, and then processes it in the background so that it can keep the discussion going with you.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-Live-1 for ChatGPT Voice users on Go, Plus, and Pro plans, with GPT-Live-1 Mini as the default for free users.
key_facts.excerpt: Starting today, OpenAI is rolling out two versions of GPT Live: GPT-Live-1, powering ChatGPT Voice for Go, Plus, and Pro Users, and GPT-Live-1 Mini, the default for free users.

sources.title: How OpenAI's voice assistant got more natural

stories.headline: OpenAI says about 30% of SWE-Bench Pro tasks are broken

key_facts.fact: OpenAI said on July 8, 2026, that a detailed audit found widespread task issues in SWE-Bench Pro.
key_facts.excerpt: Through a detailed audit, we find widespread task issues in SWE-Bench Pro and estimate that ~30% of the tasks are broken.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI estimated that roughly 30% of SWE-Bench Pro tasks are broken.
key_facts.excerpt: We find 30% of SWE-Bench Pro tasks to be broken.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI said the issues can distort results, including cases where correct solutions fail because of hidden requirements or contradictory instructions.
key_facts.excerpt: Some correct solutions fail because of hidden requirements, contradictory instructions.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI retracted its earlier recommendation to adopt SWE-Bench Pro as a benchmark for frontier coding capability.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI says it found widespread task issues in SWE-Bench Pro, estimates ~30% of tasks are broken, and retracts its earlier recommendation to adopt the benchmark.

sources.title: Separating signal from noise in coding evaluations

stories.headline: Cognition releases SWE-1.7, a coding model served at 1,000 TPS

key_facts.fact: Cognition launched SWE-1.7 on July 8, 2026, calling it the most capable model it had trained so far.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, we're launching SWE-1.7, the most capable model we've trained so far.

key_facts.fact: Cognition said SWE-1.7 was trained from a Kimi K2.7 base after Kimi had already undergone extensive RL post-training.
key_facts.excerpt: Since SWE-1.7 was trained from a Kimi K2.7 base, which had already undergone extensive RL post-training, the large additional gains from our own training challenge the idea of a 'post-training ceiling'.

key_facts.fact: SWE-1.7 is available in Devin web, desktop, and CLI via Cerebras at 1,000 tokens per second.
key_facts.excerpt: SWE-1.7 is available today in Devin (Web, Desktop, and CLI) via Cerebras at 1000 TPS.

key_facts.fact: Cognition reported pass rates of 42.3% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main, 81.5% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and 77.8% on SWE-Bench Multilingual.
key_facts.excerpt: FrontierCode 1.1 Main 42.3%; Terminal-Bench 2.1 81.5%; SWE-Bench Multilingual 77.8%.

key_facts.fact: The company said its RL training spans four datacenters across three continents.
key_facts.excerpt: Our RL training spans four datacenters across three continents, combining our own GPUs across multiple clusters with additional compute from inference providers like Fireworks.

sources.title: SWE-1.7: Frontier Intelligence at a Fraction of the Cost

stories.headline: Prime Intellect raises $130M Series A at a $1B valuation

key_facts.fact: Prime Intellect raised a $130 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation.
key_facts.excerpt: Prime Intellect, a startup that provides computing power and specialized software tools that help companies build AI agents, has raised a $130 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation.

key_facts.fact: The round was led by Radical Ventures, with participation from Nvidia Ventures, Intel Capital, Dell Technologies Capital, and Iconiq.
key_facts.excerpt: The massive round was led by Radical Ventures, with participation from Nvidia Ventures, Intel Capital, Dell Technologies Capital, Iconiq.

key_facts.fact: Prime Intellect sells a full stack for AI agent development that includes compute access, a reinforcement learning framework, and evaluation tools.
key_facts.excerpt: The startup has developed what it calls a 'full stack' for AI agent development, which includes compute access, a reinforcement learning framework, and evaluation tools.

key_facts.fact: TechCrunch reported that Prime Intellect customers include Ramp, Zapier, and Flapping Airplanes, helping push annualized revenue run rate to $100 million.
key_facts.excerpt: The startup's approach has attracted customers like Ramp, Zapier, and Flapping Airplanes... This rapid adoption has propelled the company to an annualized revenue run rate of $100 million.

sources.title: Prime Intellect raises $130M Series A to help enterprises build their own AI agents

stories.headline: AI sales-agent startup Alta raises $25M Series A

key_facts.fact: Israeli startup Alta raised a $25 million Series A on July 8, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Israeli startup Alta, which develops an AI agent platform for marketing, sales, and business development teams, has raised $25 million in Series A funding.

key_facts.fact: The round was led by IN Venture, Sumitomo Corporation's investment arm, with participation from Mindset Ventures, Skywell Capital, Leumitech77, and existing investors.
key_facts.excerpt: The round was led by IN Venture, the investment arm of Japanese conglomerate Sumitomo Corporation, with participation from Mindset Ventures, Skywell Capital, Leumitech77, and existing investors.

key_facts.fact: Alta has now raised $32 million total after a previous $7 million seed round.
key_facts.excerpt: The new funding follows a $7 million Seed round, bringing Alta's total capital raised to $32 million.

key_facts.fact: The company said revenue grew 800% in less than a year and reached a $15 million new revenue run rate.
key_facts.excerpt: In less than a year, the company has increased revenue by 800% and reached $15 million in new revenue run rate.

key_facts.fact: Alta says its platform integrates data from more than 50 sources and connects with more than 60 go-to-market and data tools.
key_facts.excerpt: The system integrates data from more than 50 sources and hundreds of buying signals... The platform operates on top of existing infrastructure and integrates with more than 60 go-to-market and data tools.

sources.title: Alta raises $25 million Series A: 'We're doing for marketing and sales what AWS did for cloud infrastructure'
